waypoints.name: Shuksan Crag Pullout
waypoints.note: Roadside crag on the left side of unpaved Hannegan Pass Road, about 2 minutes' drive from Mt. Baker Highway (SR-542) near milepost 46.
waypoints.directions: From Bellingham, take the Mt. Baker Highway (SR 542) east through Glacier and continue about 13.3 miles to an unpaved turn on the left, Hannegan Pass Road (FS Road 32), just before the highway crosses the Nooksack River near milepost 46. Follow Hannegan Pass Road roughly two minutes, a fraction of a mile, to a pullout at about 1,000 feet. The crag is the obvious cliff on the left, only a few feet off the road, so there is no approach to speak of. The rock season runs spring to autumn while the road is open.

waypoints.name: Shuksan Crag topout
waypoints.note: these routes are literally roadside, directly beside the Hannegan Pass Road pullout; trailhead, base, and topout are effectively the same point.
waypoints.directions: Walk or scramble around the side of the cliff, about 50 ft high, to the tree on top above the crack, where a static line is normally left rigged. Inspect that line before trusting it; the bolts on the face are old and should not be used.

waypoints.name: Shuksan Crag (base of cliff)
waypoints.directions: Rig a top-rope from the tree above the crack and lower down the line to the base, at the foot of the wall's most obvious continuous crack system beside the road.
